meta.title: Improve bulk data loading performance
meta.body_summary: Add optional flush control in Store.save, expose flush through Cog APIs, add flush_all for batch flushing, and bump version to 3.0.8 to improve bulk data loading performance.

perf_labels.notes: OpenAI_Codex added flush control for bulk loading; only bot review with minor suggestions, PR closed without merge; no performance evidence.

core_change_summary.description: Added flush parameter to Store.save and Cog API methods with default flush=True; introduced flush_all to batch flush all stores; updated loader functions to call flush_all after bulk data loops; bumped version to 3.0.8.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Version bump and newline fixes only.
